abstract: A review of the histology, clinical findings and results of therapy in 9 females with endodermal sinus tumor (EST) is presented. Five patients had histologically pure EST; 4 had EST mixed with other germ cell components. The site of primary tumor was the ovary in 8 of the 9 females; the remaining patient with an extraovarian primary represents the first reported case of EST arising in the vulva. The addition of combination chemotherapy has prolonged survival over historical controls treated with surgery or surgery plus irradiation. Adjuvant chemotherapy appears warranted as treatment for occult metastatic disease; postoperative radiation therapy appears useful in providing local control of primary disease. There is a suggestion of increased sensitivity of EST to combination chemotherapy as compared to other germ cell histologies with which it is commonly admixed.
abstract_ja: 女性の卵黄嚢腫瘍(EST)9例について、組織像、臨床所見、治療成績を検討した。5例は組織学的に純粋なEST、4例は他の胚細胞成分と混在していた。原発巣は9例中8例が卵巣であった。残る1例は卵巣外原発で、外陰部に発生したESTの初めての報告例である。併用化学療法の追加により、手術単独または手術と放射線療法による従来の対照例と比較して生存期間が延長した。顕微鏡的転移の可能性があるため補助化学療法が正当化されると思われ、術後放射線療法は原発巣の局所制御に有用と思われる。ESTは、しばしば混在する他の胚細胞組織型と比べて、併用化学療法に対する感受性が高い可能性がある。
